data.title: Shape Measurement and Conversion
data.description: Measure each shape with the ruler and convert your length from inches to centimeters.

challenges.label: Red Rectangle
challenges.hint: Measure from 0, not from 1. Where does the shape end?

challenges.label: Blue Rectangle
challenges.hint: The small marks between the numbers are halves. Count carefully.

challenges.label: Green Square
challenges.hint: Line the left edge up with 0, then read where the right edge lands.

challenges.label: Sky Rectangle
challenges.hint: Count the big tick marks from 0 to the edge of the shape.
